searchText: I think I have found the bug. It's related to Kurtosis. So if I run this, lodestar is fine and Geth is not complaining about engine_newPayloadV5 ``` electra_fork_epoch: 0 fulu_fork_epoch: 1 eip7805_fork_epoch: 2 ``` but if I run this, it will complain ``` electra_fork_epoch: 0 eip7805_fork_epoch: 2 ``` I checked the EL config generated by Kurtosis, it looks like former case it will generate ``` "shanghaiTime":0, "cancunTime":0, "pragueTime":0, "osakaTime":1742275837 ``` but the latter, it will generate ``` "shanghaiTime":0, "cancunTime":0, "pragueTime":0, "osakaTime":20942276601 ``` the latter osaka time is 12 times larger than the former osaka time, so when the proper eip7805 fork is activated, EL still thinks it's in Pectra `20942276601` is like Aug 2633 (seconds from unix epoch) I like this design, however, would this require to also charge tx.value upfront? I'd say so, otherwise this could lead to a skip that isn't the builder's fault? I think this is related to genesis generator. It seems it sets Osaka time only when `fulu_fork_epoch` is set: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator/blob/master/apps/el-gen/genesis_geth.py#L234-L239 In other words, I've checked this works correctly: ``` electra_fork_epoch: 0 fulu_fork_epoch: 1 eip7805_fork_epoch: 1 ``` However, not sure why but Dora says all ILs are empty. Could you please check Lodestar regarding this one?

excerpts.content:
So if I run this, lodestar is fine and Geth is not complaining about engine_newPayloadV5
```
  electra_fork_epoch: 0
  fulu_fork_epoch: 1
  eip7805_fork_epoch: 2
```
but if I run this, it will complain
```
  electra_fork_epoch: 0
  eip7805_fork_epoch: 2
```

excerpts.author: nc1234
excerpts.content:
I checked the EL config generated by Kurtosis, it looks like former case it will generate
```
"shanghaiTime":0,
"cancunTime":0,
"pragueTime":0,
"osakaTime":1742275837
```
but the latter, it will generate
```
"shanghaiTime":0,
"cancunTime":0,
"pragueTime":0,
"osakaTime":20942276601
```
the latter osaka time is 12 times larger than the former osaka time, so when the proper eip7805 fork is activated, EL still thinks it's in Pectra

excerpts.content:
I think this is related to genesis generator. It seems it sets Osaka time only when `fulu_fork_epoch` is set: https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-genesis-generator/blob/master/apps/el-gen/genesis_geth.py#L234-L239

In other words, I've checked this works correctly:
```
  electra_fork_epoch: 0
  fulu_fork_epoch: 1
  eip7805_fork_epoch: 1
```

However, not sure why but Dora says all ILs are empty. Could you please check Lodestar regarding this one?
